top_signals.title: Turkey Picks Tax Chief to Lead Markets Board After Fund Rout
top_signals.summary: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan appointed Muhsin Atci, head of the nation’s tax inspection body, as chief of the Capital Markets Board to help deal with an investment fund crisis that rocked financial markets.
